name: Local Laya
author: v3moreno
description: Run the laya decision daemon from a folder, on CPU or GPU, optionally at login — or install laya straight from the widget, then wire its MCP proxy and hooks into your coding agents. The panel shows a lifetime request grid, token graph, per-checkpoint stats, latency and GPU telemetry; start, stop, restart, mode, autostart, agent wiring and updates are a keystroke away.

barWidget.description: Start laya-serve from a folder at login; status and lifecycle in the bar.
